segments.text: Sleep tight. Don't let the bedbugs bite.
Don't worry, it's just a saying.
I think there are bugs in my bed.
I think father bear swallowed a bedbug.
You just can't escape those bedbugs.
Bedbugs in the bed, father bear.
You look like a bedbug to me.
Bedbugs bites feel more like tickles.
Because we only have little teeth.
They sneak up on you and...
Bedbugs like to have pillow fights.
Are you two bedbugs getting tired yet?
Are any bedbugs still hiding in the pillows?
I better get this blanket a good shake.
Bedbugs like to hold on tight.
Now we're as snug as three bugs in a rug.
It's just a saying little bear.
